entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Diana, Agent ID 401. How can I help you today?
Hi Diana, I'm calling about the VeloBand GPS Tracker I bought. I'd like to start a return for it.
I can certainly look into that for you. To best assist, could you tell me a bit more about what's going on? Is it a technical fault with the band, or more of a preference issue?
It's not broken or anything, but it's just really hard to use. I found the menu system very confusing. Honestly, I expected more from the interface.
I'm sorry to hear it's not been as intuitive as you'd hoped. I appreciate that feedback. Can you give me an example of a feature that you're finding confusing?
Well, setting up the custom workout screens. I read the user manual, and it seemed like I had to go through five different sub-menus just to change one data field. It's just not practical.

Ah, I see. That's a common point of confusion. There's actually a much faster way to do that directly in the VeloFit app that syncs to the band, rather than trying to configure it on the small screen itself. If you open the app and go to 'Device Settings' and then 'Display,' you can drag and drop the data fields you want. It should update the band in a few seconds.
Oh. I didn't even think to look there. Let me see... wow, okay. That's a thousand times easier. That actually solves my biggest complaint.

I'm glad to hear it! It's designed that way so you can do all the complex setup on your phone. Now, I do need to let you know, as I'm looking at your account, I see the VeloBand Pulse was delivered 17 days ago. For that specific device, we have a strict 10-day return window due to hygiene protocols and how the hardware activates to a user's account. So a return wouldn't be possible at this stage.

I understand the policy, but given that the setup was so unintuitive, it took me over a week to even find the time to really try and figure it out. Since the user manual wasn't very clear on that point, would you be able to offer a small discount code for a future purchase, just for the inconvenience?

I appreciate you asking and I can definitely see your perspective. While I can't offer credits or discounts for preference-related issues, I can absolutely pass your feedback about the user manual on to our technical writing team. We're always trying to improve our documentation. Now that the display issue is sorted, are you feeling a bit better about keeping the VeloBand?
Yes, actually. Knowing I can customize it that easily makes a huge difference. That was the main reason I wanted to send it back. I'll keep it. Thanks for your help.
You're very welcome! I'm happy we could find a solution for you. Is there anything else I can assist with today?
No, that's all. Thank you, Diana.
It was my pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great rest of your day.
